entries.b75df45be1d44777: It can be read that, as the second year of the Medium-term Management Plan 2026, the company is focusing on investment in human capital and promotion of AAS-DX, and in response to aging infrastructure such as water and sewerage systems, has begun jointly developing with AI startup companies a voice-based leak detection AI linked to a water supply GIS, has tested inspection robots at sewage treatment plants, and has moved to make a company engaged in the design and maintenance of water and sewerage systems a subsidiary.
entries.c16974dfda60bfc3: A spatial information consultant that, starting from aerial surveying, supports the development of social infrastructure and national land conservation with spatial information technology.
entries.c3484b4b36b25cd8: The Long-term Vision 2033 sets the mission as 'connecting society through spatial information technology and creating the future of the Earth.' Its first phase, the Medium-term Management Plan 2026, takes 'establishing portfolio management of businesses' and 'forming a corporate group where diverse talent gathers' as its themes, and pursues both business strategy and corporate management strategy as the two wheels of its approach, on the foundation of sustainable management and the AAS-DX philosophy.
